title: Trump wants to reduce the cost of fuel as the midterms loom - will it work?
summary: The price of fuel has risen significantly as the cost of living becomes a central concern for American voters ahead of the midterms. Trump's proposal to reduce fuel costs addresses this key issue, though effectiveness remains unclear.
content: The price of fuel has soared as the cost of living emerges as a key issue for millions of Americans.

zh.title: 中期选举逼近，特朗普想降低燃料成本——会有效果吗？
zh.summary: 随着中期选举临近，燃料价格大幅上升，生活成本成为美国选民的中心关切。特朗普降低燃料成本的提议针对这一关键问题，但其有效性仍不明确。

title: New York City man shot in car with child present by ICE agents, mayor says
summary: ICE agents shot and wounded a man during a targeted immigration operation in the Bronx, with a 5-year-old child present in the vehicle. The incident raises concerns about operational protocols and civilian safety during law enforcement actions.
content: ICE agents shot and wounded a man in a Bronx car with a 5-year-old inside during a targeted immigration operation, officials said.

title: Stock futures edge higher after OpenAI's revenue report prompts tech sector turmoil: Live updates
summary: The Nasdaq Composite fell more than 1% on Thursday, its largest single-day decline since mid-August, following OpenAI's revenue report that disappointed investors. The sell-off reflects renewed caution in the technology sector after the AI rally.
content: The Nasdaq Composite dropped more than 1% on Thursday, marking its biggest one-day loss since mid-August.

title: 'Real boss of India?': Elon Musk takes aim at Indian billionaire Ambani as Starlink launch stalls
summary: Elon Musk has criticized Indian billionaire Ambani, claiming Starlink's launch in India has stalled despite five years of regulatory compliance efforts. The dispute highlights tensions between Musk and Indian business interests over market access.
content: Musk claimed Starlink was not being allowed to launch in India despite spending five years complying with every single law and requirement of the government.

title: Nvidia-backed AI data centre firm scraps mega listing due to market volatility
summary: Firmus, a Nvidia-backed AI data center company, has cancelled its IPO citing recent market volatility and unfavorable conditions. The withdrawal reflects cautious sentiment toward major technology infrastructure offerings.
content: Firmus said it had made the decision due to "recent market volatility and prevailing market conditions".

title: Adidas sues Australian label White Fox over four stripes design
summary: Adidas has filed a lawsuit against Sydney-based fashion label White Fox, alleging trademark infringement over the use of four stripes on clothing. The case centers on Adidas's iconic three-stripe design and its brand protection efforts.
content: The German sportswear brand wants the Sydney-based label to stop selling the clothes and pay damages.

title: U.S. East Asian envoy says investors are overpricing Taiwan conflict risk
summary: A U.S. diplomat asserted that investors are overestimating the risk of military conflict across the Taiwan Strait as a deterrence measure against Chinese action. The statement reflects U.S. efforts to maintain investor confidence in regional stability.
content: Investors are overestimating the risk of conflict across the Taiwan Strait, a U.S. diplomat says, playing up deterrence to keep Beijing from taking the island.

title: SpaceX’s Starlink Mobile plans are pressuring AT&T and Verizon shares
summary: SpaceX plans to acquire Grain Management's 800 MHz spectrum portfolio to advance its mobile service ambitions, putting competitive pressure on established carriers AT&T and Verizon. The announcement is buoying cell-tower stocks as investors anticipate infrastructure demand.
content: SpaceX plans to purchase Grain Management’s 800 MHz spectrum portfolio in a move to bolster its mobile ambitions. The news is lifting cell-tower stocks.
